brief.headline: Blackstone, Warburg Pincus and Apollo in talks to back GTCR’s $50bn Global Payments bid
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Blackstone, Warburg Pincus and Apollo Global Management are in talks to help finance GTCR’s proposed $50bn take-private of payments processor Global Payments, according to a report by Reuters.
Hotels & Hospitality: Host Hotels & Resorts has secured three retail spaces and an indoor parking area at its newly acquired hotel asset in Brooklyn’s Dumbo neighborhood.
Fundraising: BlackRock has launched the BlackRock HKD Digital Liquidity Fund, its first tokenized fund in Hong Kong and the Asia-Pacific region, the firm said in a statement on Tuesday.

Regulation & Policy: KKR has introduced restrictions on employees’ use of prediction markets, setting out rules for trading contracts tied to real-world events in a recent staff memo, according to a report by The Wall Street Journal.
M&A & Buyouts: The streaming giant announced Tuesday that it is purchasing the 55-acre, 1.2 million-square-foot Radford Studio Center in Studio City for $380 million from Goldman Sachs.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. The S&P 500 stands at 7,201.09 (down 0.5% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 26.4, an elevated reading that signals nervous markets. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.92% (unchanged on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.28 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.72%, near long-run norms (up 9 bps on the prior reading).
